Bihar Floods Affect Millions as Ganga River Breaches Record Levels

Millions of people in Bihar have been affected by severe floods, with the Ganga River's water level breaking records in several areas. At least 11 to 12 districts have been impacted, affecting an estimated 1.685 million to 2.24 million people. Villages in areas like Raghopur have been submerged. Authorities are reviewing aerial surveys and relief efforts in response to the crisis.
